accuracyTiers.direct: 2020 population and housing units are whole-block counts aggregated after geographic assignment.
accuracyTiers.modeled: ACS block-group counts are allocated with 2020 block population or housing-unit weights. Percentages are ratios of allocated estimates.
accuracyTiers.notIncluded: The files do not infer individual behavior, party registration, or who voted.

sources.name: 2020 Census TIGERweb Census Blocks
sources.use: Block geometry, population, housing units, and land area

sources.name: MassGIS Wards and Precincts 2022
sources.use: Precinct geometry and published 2020 precinct population check

sources.name: 2020-2024 American Community Survey 5-year
sources.use: Block-group demographic, social, economic, and housing estimates

census_block_to_precinct.csv.grain: One row per 2020 Census block assigned to a district precinct

importantFields.overlap_pct_of_block: Share of block polygon area inside assigned precinct

importantFields.person_weight: Allocated block population / whole block-group population
importantFields.household_weight: Allocated block housing units / whole block-group housing units
importantFields.district_person_weight_share: Sum of person weights entering all district precincts

importantFields.*_est: Modeled ACS estimate allocated from block groups
importantFields.*_moe: ACS sampling margin of error combined by root-sum-of-squares; allocation-model error is additional and not measured
importantFields.*_pct: Ratio of allocated ACS estimates; no separate modeled margin of error is claimed
